data.name: Daftarun
data.gender_notes: Daftarun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'daftar' meaning a book or register. The name 'Daftarun' can be interpreted as 'Little Book'. The name Daftarun carries the meaning “Little Book” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Daftarun usually hope their child will grow to embody little book and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and the power of the written word.
data.etymology: Daftarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Book.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daftarun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: دفترون
in_arabic.meaning: دفترون تعني السجل أو الكتاب الذي يحتوي على معلومات
in_arabic.long_meaning: دفترون هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'د-ف-ر' والذي يعني السجل أو الكتاب. يشير إلى كتاب أو سجل يحتوي على معلومات أو بيانات مهمة. في السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يشير إلى كتاب الله أو القرآن الكريم، الذي يعتبره المسلمون كتابهم المقدس. اسم دفترون يعكس قيمة العلم والمعرفة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: دفترون
in_urdu.meaning: دفترون مطلب ہے ریکارڈ یا کتاب جس میں معلومات درج ہوں
in_urdu.long_meaning: دفترون ایک عربی جڑ 'د-ف-ر' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ریکارڈ یا کتاب۔ یہ نام علم اور علم کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، دفترون جیسے نام علم اور روحانیت کے اتحاد کی نمائندگی کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: दफ्तरुन
in_hindi.meaning: दफ्तरुन का अर्थ है रिकॉर्ड या पुस्तक जिसमें जानकारी हो
in_hindi.long_meaning: दफ्तरुन नाम अरबी मूल 'द-फ-र' से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है रिकॉर्ड या पुस्तक। यह नाम ज्ञान और शिक्षा के महत्व को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, दफ्तरुन जैसे नामों का चयन बच्चे के लिए आध्यात्मिक और शैक्षिक उत्कृष्टता की कामना को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: دفترون
in_pashto.meaning: دفترون معنی دے ریکارډ یا کتاب چی معلومات پکې وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: دفترون نوم د عربي ريښو 'د-ف-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ریکارډ یا کتاب معنی لري. دا نوم د پوهې او زده کړې اهميت ښيي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښو له مخې، دفترون په دې معنی دی چې د یو شخص د پوهې او حکمت ذخیره ده.

in_english.name: Daftarun
in_english.meaning: Daftarun means a record or book containing information
in_english.long_meaning: The name Daftarun is derived from the Arabic root 'د-ف-ر' (d-f-r), meaning a record or book. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the importance of knowledge and scripture. The Quran, considered the holy book of God by Muslims, is a central reference. Daftarun reflects the value of written knowledge and wisdom in Islamic culture. Historically, such names were chosen to invoke blessings of knowledge and understanding.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Daftarun' holds a significant cultural impact as it is deeply rooted in the Arab and Islamic tradition of knowledge being precious and essential. Books and written records have always held high esteem in Islamic culture, signifying wisdom, education, and knowledge. The term 'daftar' itself is used to describe various types of official records, documents, and even account books. The name Daftarun can thus be seen as a reminder of the importance of learning, record keeping, and the preservation of knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Daftarun' holds immense significance as it is a constant reminder of the importance of knowledge in the quest for spiritual growth. In Islamic tradition, knowledge is considered to be a form of worship, and it is through learning and acquiring knowledge that one can come closer to God. The 'Little Book' moniker can be seen as a reminder of the Quran, the holy scripture of Islam, and the significance of reading and understanding it regularly. The name 'Daftarun' thus carries a powerful message, encouraging one to seek knowledge, deepen their understanding of the divine teachings, and strive towards spiritual growth.
